title: Strategic Finance Manager
description:
Greenlight is a family technology company on a mission to help families raise financially smart kids and navigate life together. Its suite of products - including the Greenlight app, debit card, Safe Family GPS trackers, and Family Hub - brings together financial tools, safety features, and everyday family management in one connected experience. Designed for busy families who want convenience without compromise, Greenlight continues to innovate alongside the evolving needs of modern life. Today, more than 6.5 million family members trust Greenlight to stay in sync.
At Greenlight, we're here to make the day-to-day easier and futures brighter, so families can spend less time managing life, and more time living it. That's why we get out of bed every morning.
 

We are seeking a Strategic Finance Manager to collaborate with cross-functional leaders and drive outcomes across the business. In addition to traditional finance responsibilities of developing budgets, forecasts, and monthly/quarterly reports, this role will have significant involvement in new product analysis, data analytics, strategic projects, and company-wide planning. This position will report to the Finance Team Lead and collaborate with executives across all departments.
We are looking for a true thought leader. A successful candidate should be self-motivated, hands-on, act as a proactive business partner and demonstrate the leadership capacity to assume increasing responsibility over time. This role is fast-paced and will have a direct impact on the company's ability to make key business decisions and grow efficiently.

Our stance on salaries:
Greenlight provides a competitive compensation package with a market-based approach to pay and will vary depending on your location, experience and skill set. The total compensation package for this position will also include a discretionary performance bonus, equity rewards, medical benefits, 401K match, and more. Greenlight conducts continuous compensation evaluations across departments and geographies to ensure we are keeping our pay current and competitive.
 
The estimated base pay range for this position in (NY, CA, WA): $125,000- 170,000
The estimated base pay range for this position in (CO): $125,000- 145,000

Who we are:
It takes a talented team to aim for a mission like ours. We're looking for people who ask "is it bold enough?" People who bring their real selves to the table and push the people around them to do the same. We win by never hesitating to jump in, offer a hand, or share the credit, because we know we're stronger together than apart. And through all of it, the mission stays the thing we measure ourselves against: are we doing right by the families counting on us? If that sounds like your kind of team, we'd love for you to apply.

title: Utilization Management Specialist
description:
Align yourself with an organization that has a reputation for excellence! Cedars-Sinai was awarded the National Research Corporation’s Consumer Choice Award 19 times for providing the highest-quality medical care in Los Angeles. We also were awarded the Advisory Board Company’s Workplace of the Year. This annual award recognizes hospitals and health systems nationwide that have outstanding levels of employee engagement. We offer an outstanding benefits package that includes health care, paid time off, and a 403(B). Join us! Discover why U.S. News & World Report has named us one of America’s Best Hospitals.
What You Will Do in This Role:
The Utilization Management Specialist provides advanced operational and workflow support to Utilization Review (UR) Nurses to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant execution of the utilization review process. This position performs complex, non-clinical functions that directly support payer communication, authorization coordination, documentation integrity, and regulatory compliance.
The Utilization Management Specialist maintains an assigned portfolio of cases in partnership with multiple UR Nurses and is accountable for oversight of authorization workflows from initial submission, follow-up through to final determination. The role applies independent judgment in prioritizing cases based on payer deadlines, regulatory requirements, and authorization expiration risk.
In collaboration with UR Nurses, Case Management, Revenue Cycle, and external payers, the Utilization Management Specialist ensures documentation and authorization activities are complete, accurate, and executed within established timeframes. This position plays a critical role in supporting revenue integrity, denial prevention, and compliance with CMS and payer specific requirements.
The role operates in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment using EPIC/CS-Link, AIDIN, payer portals, and related UM systems to proactively manage workflows and remove administrative barriers that could delay review completion or payer communication.

• Maintain an assigned portfolio of cases in partnership with UR Nurses to support timely utilization review activities.

• Prepare and assemble clinical review packets and supporting documentation for payer submission.

• Review records to confirm required documentation elements are present prior to submission and escalate gaps to the assigned UR Nurse.

• Track submission confirmations and ensure timely follow up on pending payer determinations.

• Manage the authorization lifecycle for assigned cases, including entry, tracking, follow up, documentation of determinations, and monitoring of payer response timelines.

• Monitor payer portals and contact payers directly, as needed, to obtain authorization updates and resolve status discrepancies.

• Independently prioritize cases based on submission deadlines, authorization expiration risk, and regulatory timeframes.

• Escalate urgent authorization issues, delays, or barriers that may result in avoidable denials or authorization lapses.

• Coordinate peer to peer scheduling logistics and maintain related documentation.

• Document and communicate payer determinations, including approvals, partial approvals, and denials, in EPIC/CS-Link in accordance with departmental and regulatory standards.

• Identify patterns or systemic authorization workflow issues and communicate trends to UM leadership.

• Document and communicate payer determinations, including approvals, partial approvals, and denials.

• Ensure all required documentation is accurately entered into EPIC/CS-Link in accordance with departmental and regulatory standards.

• Communicate effectively with internal and external partners to ensure patient and authorization information is current and complete.

*Approved Remote States: Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Minnesota, Nevada, Oregon, Texas*

title: Software Engineer (School of Medicine - Medvitals)
description:
The Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine is seeking a Software Engineer to support the Medvitals Team. The Software Engineer is responsible for the creation, implementation, maintenance, performance, production support and documentation of various departmental and enterprise-wide application systems. This includes but is not limited to the installation, modification, and testing of new and/or upgraded applications (packages or homegrown), operating systems, file structures, hardware, communication devices, and productivity tools. Applies analysis techniques and procedures to gather and then translate business requirements into functional/technical specifications and designs. Using functional specifications and designs, produces all or part of the deliverables. Maintains databases and application system code.
Responsible for full life cycle of medium to large sized complex projects; strong technical skills; strong ability to understand complex business processes. Develops solutions based on extensive technical knowledge, skills and experience; influences client towards innovative/integrated solutions.
Specific Duties & Responsibilities

• The responsibilities listed below are typical examples of the work performed by this position.

• Not all duties assigned to this position are included, nor is it expected that everyone in this position will be assigned every job responsibility.

Analysis & Requirement Gatherings

• Define complex business/clinical/education problems by meeting with clients to observe and understand current processes and the issues related to those processes. Provide written documentation of findings to share with the client and other IT colleagues.

• Gather complex system requirements by meeting with clients and researching existing technology to understand the business requirements and possible solutions for new applications.

Design & Development

• Develop detailed tasks and project plans by analyzing project scope and milestones for complex projects to ensure product is delivered quickly according to software lifecycle standards.

• Write functional/technical specifications from the complex system requirements, putting them into functional and technical descriptions for use by programmers and business analysts to develop technical solutions.

• Develop/change data input, files/database structures, data transformation, algorithms, and data output by using appropriate computer language/tools to provide technical solutions for complex application development tasks.

• Document code and associated processes by adhering to development methodologies, adding code comments and appropriate documentation to various knowledge-base system(s) to simplify code maintenance and to improve support.

• Provide monitoring and guidance in application design and development to more junior staff.

title: Energy Associate
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

Role Scope

- Diligence prospective sites across both paths to power, grid interconnection and behind-the-meter generation, and turn each one into a go or no-go recommendation in days rather than weeks.

- Support the Leads through live negotiations with term sheet comparisons, sensitivity runs, counterparty and credit screens, and the one number that decides the question, delivered before the next call rather than after it.

- Track the markets and the policy that set the rules we build under, ISO large load processes, rate cases and tariff changes, and gas fundamentals in the basins we are buying into.

What We're Looking For

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would.

- You've built a model that someone traded, invested, or committed capital off, and you can defend every assumption in it under pressure.

- You've read a contract, tariff, or study report closely and pulled out the two or three terms that actually change the economics, rather than summarising the whole thing.

- You turn a disordered data room into a one page recommendation that names the thing the decision actually turns on.

- You've caught a material error in someone else's work before it reached a decision maker, and you raised it rather than working around it.

- You've been dropped into a market or an asset class you did not know and been useful inside a few weeks, and you can point to how you got up to speed.

- You write up what you found the same day you found it, so a site file never depends on what is in your head.

• Gross and net revenue retention at or above target across the $10K+ book, with the team's forecast accurate enough to plan on.

title: Litigation Legal Counsel
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

As a Litigation Legal Counsel, you’ll work on litigation and pre-litigation matters of the Vinted group and you will be part of the legal function.

In this position, you’ll 

• Manage litigation and pre-litigation matters touching upon regulatory, consumer affairs, platform regulations, content-related matters, privacy and commercial/contractual disputes

• Handle and streamline processes related to Request for Information received from various authorities

• Advise management stakeholders on litigation strategy and risks

• Develop creative approaches to managing legal risks and resolving disputes

• Work with and coordinate outsourced legal counsels in all the jurisdictions in which we operate

• Work closely with business teams (such as Product, PR, Customer Support, and other teams to identify and address relevant legal risks)

• Build processes (e.g. training, guidelines, etc.) with other legal peers in order to support legal compliance across the company

About you 

• An experienced mid-level lawyer with a litigation background in a law firm and/or as an in-house counsel (commercial, platform and consumer-related ideally) 

• Qualification in one bar association is a plus

• Experience managing multiple high priority projects simultaneously

• Experience managing high stakes, complex litigation

• Experience dealing with authorities (request for information, regulatory litigation, etc)

• Excellent at communicating in spoken and written English

• Platform-related litigation experience is a strong plus

• Experience managing collective actions and/or European Court of Justice proceedings is a strong plus

• The skills, willingness, and initiative to own legal issues across many different jurisdictions

• Proactivity and attention to detail

• Passionate about technology-driven businesses

Work perks 

• The opportunity to benefit from our share options programme

• 25 working days of holiday

• Newest MacBook models

• Confidential Employee Assistance Program (EAP) for you and your family

• Home office support: we provide IT workstation equipment and a personal budget of up to €540 for home workplace furniture

• Co-contribution meal vouchers for each workday through a convenient meal card

• Comprehensive Medical Coverage

• Frequent team-building events

• A personal monthly budget for shopping on Vinted

• A dog-friendly office

Working at Vinted 

Workation policy 

Better balance holidays with workdays by working remotely! Up to 90 d

title: Product Platform: Backend Engineer
description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

THE ROLE

AI is being built by many companies at once. Model labs train more capable models, hyperscalers provide infrastructure and distribution, developers build new AI products, and a growing set of tools gives agents more to work with. Baseten sits at the center of all of it, as the inference platform that developers and large companies use to run AI in production.

We’re hiring a backend/distributed systems engineer to join our Product Platform in following areas:

- Commercialization, billing, and partnerships

- Developer productivity and agentic development

- Observability platform

Please come join our growing team to work on exciting problems. A few sample projects and responsibilities will include

- Design and build scalable telemetry ingest and storage pipelines for metrics, logs, and traces across Baseten’s multi-cloud infrastructure

- Own and evolve core observability platforms, driving migrations and architectural improvements that improve reliability, reduce cost, and scale with organizational growth

- Build world class commercialization and billing systems

- Work on some of the most strategic and exciting partnership integrations

- Develop internal infrastructure and tooling that improves developer velocity, CI/CD, and deployment safety.

- Own the internal AI agent platform end to end - architecture, build, rollout, operation, measurement.

- Own Baseten's testing strategy end to end - define the standards, the tiers, and the tooling that engineering teams build against.

- Drive adoption through developer experience - good defaults, clear docs, low friction - not mandate.

- Improve platform reliability through better alerting, incident tooling, and production debugging workflows.

- Lead technical design for cross-team projects and make sound tradeoffs between speed, quality, and long-term maintainability.

- Partner with infrastructure, model performance, and product teams to understand what they need to see and ship faster.

- Raise the engineering bar through code review, mentorship, and clear technical writing.

REQUIREMENTS

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

- 5+ years of relevant industry experience, with a focus on building scalable backend systems and platforms.

- Experience building or operating observability systems (logging, metrics, tracing) or internal infrastructure at scale.

- Proficiency in Python, Go, Rust, or a similar backend language.

- A firm grasp of quality and engineering principles: you understand both the what and the why.

- Strong systems-level thinking: you understand how the components of a distributed system interact and how data flows through each part.

- Platform mindset: you build for adoption and self-service, treat internal engineers as customers, and would rather ship a good default than write a style guide.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Competitive compensation, including meaningful equity

title: Software Engineer, AI Data - Porto, Portugal
description:
Mission
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google,
leading PhD programs like Stanford, high-growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
Overview
We're looking for a Software Engineer - AI Data to join Speechify 's AI team and build the data pipelines that power our model training and next-generation AI products.
We build high-quality datasets at petabyte scale and low cost by combining engineering, infrastructure, and research. We're looking for a strong software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems, exploring new data sources, and building systems that make AI training more efficient and scalable.
What Yo u’ ll Do:

• Discover new sources of audio data and build reliable pipelines to bring them into our training datasets.

• Build and improve large-scale data-processing systems, optimizing for data quality, throughput, and cost.

• Collaborate closely with AI Scientists to improve training datasets and support the development of next-generation models.

• Take ownership of engineering projects from problem discovery through implementation and continuous improvement.

An Ideal Candidate Should Have:

• A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong backend development fundamentals.

• Proficiency in Python and Bash in Linux environments.

• Experience building and operating production systems, ideally involving data pipelines or large-scale data processing.

• Strong problem-solving skills, initiative, and the ability to work independently in ambiguous environments.

Nice to Have

• Experience with web crawlers, data acquisition, or distributed data-processing systems.

• Experience with cloud infrastructure and Infrastructure as Code, particularly GCP and Terraform.

• Familiarity with ML training data, dataset quality, or audio processing.

What We Offer

• A dynamic environment where your contributions shape the company and its products

• A team that values innovation, intuition, and drive

• Autonomy, fostering focus and creativity

• The opportunity to have a significant impact in a revolutionary industry

• Competitive compensation, a welcoming atmosphere, and a commitment to an exceptional asynchronous work culture

• The privilege of working on a product that changes lives, particularly for those with learning differences like dyslexia, ADD, and more

• An active role at the intersection of artificial intelligence and audio - a rapidly evolving tech domain

The Portugal Based Salary range for this role is: 30,000-65,000 USD/Year + Bonus + Stock depending on experience.

title: Counsel, Employment
description:

OpenAI’s Legal team plays a crucial role in advancing our mission by tackling innovative and fundamental legal issues in AI. The team includes professionals with expertise spanning technology, AI, privacy, IP, corporate, employment, tax, regulatory, and litigation. If you’re passionate about meaningful and unique work as a technology lawyer, this team is for you.

About the Role

We are seeking an employment lawyer to help build the legal foundations for OpenAI’s next stage of growth. Working closely with our employment counsel team and colleagues across the company, you will shape practical approaches to challenging employment issues in a fast-growing AI company. This is a hands-on role for a thoughtful lawyer who enjoys variety, moves quickly, and wants to help build a strong employment legal function as the business scales.

You will collaborate with experienced employment counsel on US and international employment issues, the employment aspects of mergers and acquisitions, and emerging questions about AI in the workplace. A central part of your work will be turning lessons from individual matters into practical policies, guidance, and approaches that work at scale. You will also own stakeholder relationships and manage counseling matters, exercising sound judgment and taking responsibility for outcomes. You will join a bright, collaborative team that values initiative and shared learning, with opportunities to learn from senior colleagues, deepen your expertise, and take on increasingly complex matters over time.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

- Help shape OpenAI’s employment legal approach as the company scales, developing practical policies, playbooks, and processes that address recurring issues and support sound, timely decisions.

- Collaborate with senior employment counsel and cross-functional partners on a broad range of US employment matters, including recruiting and hiring, performance management, employee conduct, leaves of absence, accommodations, and separations.

- Own designated stakeholder relationships and counseling matters, providing clear, practical advice and working independently while drawing on the team’s experience and judgment as appropriate.

- Advise on international employment matters and support the employment aspects of mergers and acquisitions, including diligence and workforce integration, collaborating with local and specialist counsel as appropriate.

- Partner on strategic projects and emerging legal questions, including the use of AI in employment and workplace practices.

- Translate legal developments and lessons from your work into useful guidance, training, brown bags, and office hours for stakeholders across the company.

- Manage employment disputes, administrative charges, and related matters in collaboration with colleagues and outside counsel, as appropriate.

- Draft and negotiate employment documents and agreements, and identify practical ways to strengthen how the company handles employment matters as it grows.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have 7+ years of relevant employment law experience at a law firm, an in-house legal team, or a combination of both, with a record of excellent work and increasing responsibility.

- Have strong knowledge of US employment law, including California law, and sound judgment in advising on a broad range of workplace matters.

- Analyze unfamiliar issues quickly and translate complex legal requirements into clear, practical recommendations that account for business needs and employee experience.

- Enjoy building in a fast-growth environment: spotting gaps, developing practical solutions, and seeing them through to implementation.

Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. • Guide our merchants and be the first point of contact for every account onboarding.

title: Silicon Design Lead
description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops AI-native silicon and system-level solutions for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. Building on efforts like Jalapeño, the team is developing future generations of AI-native silicon and tightly integrated systems to power the next generation of frontier models. By co-designing chips, systems, tools, and methodologies, the team helps deliver faster, more efficient, and production-ready hardware for OpenAI’s supercomputing platform.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Silicon Design Lead to drive architecture, microarchitecture, and implementation of key IP and subsystems for our AI hardware platforms. You will translate functional, performance, and security requirements into efficient silicon designs, owning technical decisions from architectural definition through implementation and integration.

Part of this role will focus on hardware security implementation in close partnership with OpenAI’s Security team. While the Security team owns the overarching security architecture and requirements, you will translate those requirements into silicon microarchitecture and implementation, balancing security capabilities with performance, power, area, and design complexity. The other part of this role will focus on driving general silicon architecture/microarchitecture. 

In this role, you will:

- Own architecture, microarchitecture, and implementation of silicon IP and subsystems, from requirements and design specifications through integration and validation.

- Define hardware interfaces, data flows, and microarchitectural tradeoffs to meet functional, performance, power, and area requirements.

- Partner closely with OpenAI’s Security team to translate security architecture, requirements, and threat models into implementable hardware capabilities.

- Design and integrate hardware security mechanisms, including encryption, key management, access controls, isolation, and data protection across silicon subsystems.

- Evaluate architectural and implementation tradeoffs to ensure security capabilities meet functional and performance requirements.

- Collaborate with silicon architects, RTL, verification, firmware, and software teams to drive subsystem design, integration, and validation.

- Review and contribute to RTL implementations, ensuring designs align with architectural intent and system requirements.

- Evaluate existing and third-party IP, identify architectural or implementation gaps, and drive solutions across subsystem boundaries.

You might thrive in this role if you:

- Have strong experience in silicon IP or subsystem-level architecture, microarchitecture, and implementation.

- Have owned hardware IP or subsystem designs from architectural definition through implementation and integration.

- Have experience implementing hardware security features such as memory encryption, key management, access controls, isolation, or secure boot.

- Understand how to translate functional and security requirements into hardware architectures, interfaces, and microarchitectural specifications.

- Have working knowledge of RTL design and coding proficiency in Verilog or SystemVerilog, with the ability to read, review, and contribute to RTL.

- Can evaluate performance, power, area, and complexity tradeoffs across silicon designs.

- Work effectively across security, silicon architecture, RTL, verification, firmware, and software teams to drive designs from concept through execution.

- Ideally, have broader SoC-level architecture or integration experience, though deep IP or subsystem-level expertise is sufficient.

To comply with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidates for this role may need to meet certain legal status requirements as provided in those laws and regulations.

Fotokite is the global category leader in actively tethered autonomous Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) platforms. Born as an ETH Zurich deep-tech spin-off with 22 granted patents, Fotokite combines autonomous robotics, un-jammable tethered station-keeping, and enterprise SaaS to deliver continuous 24/7 situational awareness.
With over 1,100 fielded systems dominating North American public safety, Fotokite is scaling its European commercial infrastructure.
Role Overview & Strategic Charter
We are seeking a high-caliber, battle-tested Director, US Defense & Federal Sales to own and scale Fotokite’s US Defense vertical.
This is a true Player-Coach role. You will take 100% ownership of our Defense Go-To-Market (GTM) engine-leading direct engagements with DoD contracting officers, building strategic alliances with major Defense Primes and navigating complex federal procurement pathways (IDIQs, OTAs, DLA, and Programs of Record).
The Strategic Gap You Will Bridge
Fotokite already possesses strong end-user field demonstration capabilities-our team can effectively put hardware in the hands of operators, tactical teams, and unit commanders in the field. The Fotokite team is seeking an expert who has demonstrated expertise in converting end-user demand into awarded contracts and scalable program line items. You will manage direct reports (including tactical field sales and solutions engineers) and provide the federal contracting expertise, procurement navigation, and C-suite Prime strategy required to win major defense business.
Core Responsibilities
1. Federal Contract Execution & Deal Closing (Player Focus)

• Pipeline to Contract Conversion: Take direct ownership of closing high-value deals across all branches of the US Department of Defense (Army, Air Force, Navy, Marines, USCG, SOCOM, and National Guard).

• Federal Procurement Mastery: Navigate FAR/DFARS regulations, Other Transaction Authorities (OTAs), Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR/STTR) transitions, and multi-year DoD budget cycles (POM).

• Contract Vehicle Optimization: Weaponize pre-existing contract vehicles and prime channels-including DLA Prime Vendors, GSA Schedules, and established Primes' IDIQs-to shorten procurement cycles.

2. Strategic Defense Prime Alliances & Teaming

• Prime Partnering: Architect formal teaming agreements, subcontracting arrangements, and technology integration partnerships with top-tier US Defense Primes.

• Program of Record Integration: Position Fotokite’s tethered ISR technology as a required subsystem/payload inside larger Defense Programs of Record (e.g., base security, vehicle-mounted ISR, tactical MANET relays).

3. Team Leadership & Coaching (Coach Focus)

• Manage & Mentor: Directly manage, mentor, and expand a focused team of Defense Account Executives and Federal Solutions Engineers.

• Bridge Field Demos to Legal Ink: Guide field sales reps who excel at end-user tactical demos, providing them with the structural support, proposal oversight, and contracting strategy needed to turn field enthusiasm into signed Purchase Orders.

• Operational Alignment: Work hand-in-hand with CRO and leadership to align US defense customer requirements with product development and manufacturing schedules.

4. Vertical Ownership & Executive Reporting

• Vertical Strategy: Define and execute the multi-year US Defense GTM roadmap, maintaining full accountability for the vertical’s revenue, bookings, and pipeline velocity.

• Capture Management: Lead high-stakes proposal efforts, RFP/RFI responses, and executive-level briefings for DoD program offices, Defense Innovation Units (DIU), and congressional/government affairs partners.

Candidate Qualifications & Requirements

• 8-12+ Years of Proven US Federal / Defense Sales Experience: Demonstrated track record of personally closing $1M+ defense contracts and growing federal accounts within the US DoD and Intelligence Community.

description:

- Fluency in additional European languages is a plus.

title: Civil Litigation Attorney
description:
Contract Civil Litigation Attorney
Devenere Law Collective
About Devenere Law Collective
Devenere Law Collective is a modern, collaborative law practice serving clients in matters that protect families, businesses, assets, and long-term wealth. Its work includes civil and business litigation, family law, trusts and estates, construction-related matters, corporate law, and intellectual property.
The firm operates primarily remotely but maintains an office in downtown Houston. Attorneys work collaboratively across practice areas and may be required to attend the office for trial preparation, client preparation, team collaboration, or client meetings.
The firm’s culture is intentionally collaborative and nonhierarchical. Attorneys, paralegals, case managers, and support professionals are expected to work as a team, accept constructive review, and contribute wherever their expertise is needed. The firm also values authenticity, community involvement, innovation, professionalism, and a client-centered approach.
Position Summary
Devenere Law Collective is seeking a versatile and driven Contract Civil Litigation Attorney to manage civil litigation matters in Texas state and federal courts.
This position is designed for an attorney with approximately two to five years of relevant experience who can independently handle active cases while remaining adaptable across a broad range of civil disputes. The firm is not seeking a newly licensed attorney who requires intensive mentoring, nor is it limiting the search to candidates with experience in only one narrow area of litigation.
The successful candidate will manage matters from initial assessment through resolution, draft pleadings and motions, conduct discovery, represent clients in hearings and trials, develop litigation strategy, maintain client communication, and comply with state and federal procedural requirements.
The initial engagement will be structured as a 1099 independent-contractor arrangement lasting approximately six to eight months. Successful performance may lead to an offer of full-time employment, depending on the attorney’s performance and the firm’s operational needs.
Compensation and Contract Structure
Compensation $14,400 - 18,500 Monthly (Negotiable)
Compensation is based exclusively on approved billable work entered into the firm’s system.
Logging into work, remaining available, or performing nonbillable activity does not automatically create compensable time.
Attorneys must maintain accurate, timely, descriptive, and client-chargeable billing entries.
At 160 approved billable hours per month, estimated monthly compensation ranges from approximately $14,400 to $18,400.
Actual earnings will depend on approved billable hours and the agreed contractual rate.
Contract Terms
Independent-contractor engagement.
Initial commitment of approximately six to eight months.
Approximately 160 billable hours per month expected.
No employee benefits during the contractor period.
Potential conversion to full-time employment based on performance, cultural alignment, client service, work quality, and business needs.
Candidates must understand the difference between hours worked and client-billable hours before accepting the engagement.
Work Arrangement and Geographic Requirements
This position is primarily remote, but it is not location-independent.
The selected attorney must:
Reside in or near the Greater Houston area.
Travel reliably to Harris County, Fort Bend County, and Brazoria County.
Attend hearings, mediations, depositions, trials, client meetings, and other proceedings in person.
Report to the downtown Houston office when needed for trial preparation, client preparation, team meetings, or other business purposes.
Be available for occasional matters outside the firm’s primary counties when required.
Candidates living outside the area without a realistic plan for regular in-person attendance should not be submitted.

description:
ABOUT BASETEN

Baseten powers mission-critical inference for the world's most dynamic AI companies, like Cursor, Notion, OpenEvidence, Abridge, Clay, Gamma, and Writer. By uniting applied AI research, flexible infrastructure, and seamless developer tooling, we enable companies operating at the frontier of AI to bring cutting-edge models into production. We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to ship AI products.

PRODUCT AT BASETEN

Baseten is building a new cloud for AI. Our ambition is to make inference, training, and agent execution part of one coherent platform, and to shape how the next generation of AI products gets built. Product decisions here reach from the economics of GPU infrastructure to the abstractions developers build on every day.

We’re hiring builders and tastemakers with the ambition to help create that future. You should bring a strong point of view about what should exist, the taste to make complex technology feel simple, and the technical judgment to build it alongside engineers, researchers, and designers. You’ll work directly with customers and forward deployed teams, turn emerging capabilities into new possibilities for developers, and carry an idea from early conviction through to production and adoption.

THE ROLE

Build the future of AI model routing, where every task gets the right model, automatically.

Today, developers often have to choose between models that are faster, cheaper, or more capable. But the right model isn't always the same for every request.

Grid is Baseten's intelligent model routing platform, designed to help developers get the best possible results across open and frontier models without manually managing every decision.

We're starting with coding agents, where model choice can have an enormous impact on quality, speed, and cost.

As Product Manager for Grid, you'll work with engineers, researchers, and customers to build a new category of AI infrastructure. You'll help shape how intelligent routing works, how developers control it, and how we prove it's better than choosing a single model.

- Own the product roadmap for Grid, from early developer adoption to production deployments and enterprise expansion.

- Work with researchers and engineers to improve intelligent model selection, routing policies, fallbacks, and controls.

- Build evaluation frameworks that measure real-world outcomes, including task quality, completion time, latency, and total cost.

- Shape the developer experience for onboarding, configuration, observability, and routing decisions.

- Help customers understand why a model was selected and give them confidence and control over how routing behaves.

- Work through technical challenges involving conversation history, tool compatibility, prompt caching, retries, and routing overhead.

- Partner with GTM and customers to turn early pilots into sustained adoption and revenue growth.

- A technical background in software engineering, ML engineering, research, or equivalent hands-on experience.

- Strong understanding of AI model quality, latency, cost, and the tradeoffs involved in optimizing across them.

- Excellent developer product instincts, with an appreciation for both simple APIs and enterprise-level controls.

- Comfort building emerging products where the technical approach and customer expectations are still evolving.

title: OpenStack Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Über uns:
Als Vorreiter für nachhaltige Green-IT-Cloud-Computing-Lösungen setzen wir unseren Fokus auf digitale Souveränität, Sicherheit nach europäischen Standards sowie Unabhängigkeit und Flexibilität durch den Einsatz von Open-Source-Technologien.
Open Source ist unsere DNA: Wir engagieren uns aktiv in Open-Source-Verbänden, Netzwerken und Kooperationen, um offene Standards mitzugestalten und die digitale Souveränität Europas mit innovativen IT-Lösungen zu fördern. Unsere Mission ist es, Unternehmen jeder Größe gemeinsam mit unserem Partnerökosystem dabei zu unterstützen, ihre digitale Transformation zu beschleunigen und ihre Geschäftsziele durch den Einsatz nachhaltiger Cloud-Technologien zu erreichen.
Start-up-Spirit trifft Konzern-Power: Yorizon ist eine Tochtergesellschaft von HOCHTIEF. HOCHTIEF ist ein technisch ausgerichteter, globaler Infrastrukturkonzern mit führenden Positionen in seinen Kernaktivitäten Bau, Dienstleistungen und Konzessionen/Public-Private-Partnerships (PPP) und mit Tätigkeitsschwerpunkten in Australien, Nordamerika und Europa. So verbinden wir agilen Pioniergeist und flache Hierarchien mit der Stabilität eines internationalen Konzerns.
Dein Wirkungsbereich:
Als Teil unseres DC.Ops-Teams berichtest Du an den Lead Plattform Architekten und verantwortest das, was unsere Cloud im Kern ausmacht: die OpenStack-Plattform. Sie läuft auf unserer eigenen Hardware, in unseren eigenen Rechenzentren, mit Ceph als Storage-Backend - und sie entsteht gerade erst. Das heißt: keine gewachsene Landschaft, keine Altlasten, keine Entscheidungen, die vor Deiner Zeit getroffen wurden. Du prägst die Standards, mit denen wir jede weitere Region ausrollen.
Deine Rolle:

•
OpenStack verantworten: Du betreibst und entwickelst unsere Control Plane und Compute Nodes weiter - Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Glance, Keystone, Placement und die Services, die wir als Nächstes dazunehmen. Du kennst nicht nur die Komponenten, sondern auch ihr Zusammenspiel.

•
Deployment & Lifecycle: Du rollst OpenStack reproduzierbar aus und hältst es aktuell - Deployment-Tooling wie Kolla-Ansible, OpenStack-Ansible oder OSISM, saubere Upgrade-Pfade über Releases hinweg, Rolling Upgrades ohne Ausfall für Kund:innen.

•
Neutron & Netzwerk: Neutron mit OVN bzw. Open vSwitch, Provider- und Tenant-Netze, Floating IPs, Security Groups, Load Balancing mit Octavia - Du verstehst, welchen Weg ein Paket durch die Virtualisierung tatsächlich nimmt.

•
Compute & Scheduling: KVM/libvirt als Fundament, Flavor- und Aggregate-Design, Scheduler- und Placement-Verhalten, Live Migration, Overcommit-Strategien, Quotas und Multi-Tenancy - inklusive GPU-Passthrough für unsere AI-Workloads.

•
Storage-Integration: Du sorgst dafür, dass Ceph und OpenStack sauber zusammenspielen - RBD für Nova und Cinder, Images über Glance, Object Storage über RGW - und arbeitest eng mit unserem Ceph Engineer zusammen.

•
Debugging auf tiefer Ebene: Hängende Nova-Instanzen, RabbitMQ unter Last, Galera-Cluster mit Eigenleben, Neutron-Agents, die nicht mehr melden - Du gehst bis auf Log- und Kernel-Ebene und findest die Ursache statt des Symptoms.

•
Automatisierung als Standard: Ansible, Terraform/OpenTofu, GitOps mit Flux, CI/CD - was zweimal passiert, passiert bei uns automatisiert. Eigene Tools in Python oder Bash gehören dazu.

•
You built it - you run it: Mit ausgeprägter Hands-on-Mentalität begleitest Du neue Regionen von der Inbetriebnahme bis in den stabilen Betrieb - gemeinsam mit unseren Datacenter Engineers vor Ort.

•
Architektur & Wissen: Du prägst Architektur-, Design- und Integrationsentscheidungen, etablierst Standards und teilst Dein Wissen aktiv im Team - Runbooks, Troubleshooting-Guides, Pairing.

Das bringst du mit:

•
OpenStack in Produktion: Du hast OpenStack-Umgebungen produktiv betrieben, erweitert und durch Upgrades gebracht. Begriffe wie Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Keystone, Placement, Octavia oder Ironic sind für Dich Alltag, nicht Theorie - und Du weißt aus eigener Erfahrung

title: Business Development Manager, Federal

title: AML Compliance Manager
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

The AML Compliance Manager will support the day-to-day execution of the AML/CFT compliance framework. This is a hands-on role requiring 3 - 4 years of AML compliance experience, focused on customer due diligence, PEP and high-risk customer approvals, first-line escalations, ongoing monitoring, and preparation of AML governance materials for senior management.

In this position, you’ll 

• Review customer onboarding and periodic review files prepared by the first line of defense.

• Assess KYC completeness, customer risk ratings, beneficial ownership, ownership structures, business rationale, and expected activity.

• Perform Enhanced Due Diligence on higher-risk customers, including review of source of funds, source of wealth, geographic risk, adverse media, and transaction rationale.

• Review and approve, or recommend approval of, higher-risk customers in line with internal procedures.

• Assess PEP cases and prepare PEP approval recommendations for Compliance or senior management.

• Review AML/CFT escalations from the first line and provide clear compliance advice.

• Challenge incomplete or insufficient first-line analysis and request additional information where needed.

• Review sanctions, PEP, and adverse media screening alerts and escalate material issues.

• Review SAR related escalations and SAR drafts to be filed to local FIU.

• Support ongoing monitoring, trigger-event reviews, and periodic KYC refreshes.

• Identify AML/CFT red flags and escalate potential suspicious activity in accordance with internal procedures.

• Prepare AML governance material, including customer approval memos, escalation summaries, risk assessments, and management reporting.

• Maintain logs of approvals, escalations, exceptions, and pending actions.

• Support updates to AML/CFT procedures, checklists, controls, and internal guidance.

• Assist with audit, regulatory, and internal compliance requests when required.

About you 

• 3-4 years’ experience in AML/CFT, KYC, customer due diligence, or financial crime compliance.

• Good understanding of Luxembourg and EU AML/CFT requirements.

• Practical experience reviewing customer onboarding files, KYC documentation, beneficial ownership, risk ratings, source of funds and source of wealth.

• Experience assessing higher-risk customers, PEPs, complex structures, adverse media, and sanctions-related alerts.

• Experience with SAR drafting and filing to local FIU.

• Ability to review and challenge first-line-of-defense escalations.

title: Order & Delivery Coordinator (C-UAS)
description: Your next mission Anchor our system deliveries. Connect internal teams seamlessly - so our life-saving radars reach the front lines without delay. As our Order & Delivery Coordinator (C-UAS), you run the administrative engine behind dispatching our IRIS radar systems. You take charge of order flows in Odoo ERP, align documentation, and organise clean internal handovers from Operations to dispatch readiness. Working alongside Project Management, Customer Success, and Operations, you keep our internal gears turning smoothly. Your sharp attention to detail ensures our teams stay focused and our radars deploy on schedule. What you'll do Order processing and data integrity : Process incoming sales orders in Odoo ERP across the entire lifecycle. Verify system data, hardware configurations, and commercial terms with high accuracy. Maintain order statuses, serial numbers, and delivery confirmations daily. Compliance and export documentation : Compile and verify complete delivery documentation packages before dispatch. Review export control paperwork, QA certificates, shipping manifests, and packing lists. Ensure every system leaves our premises with watertight paperwork. Logistics coordination and internal handovers : Coordinate handovers with the Warehouse and Logistics crew with complete shipping files. Monitor dispatch statuses once Operations releases each radar system. Keep internal handovers structured, clean, and ready for physical freight execution. Cross-functional status tracking : Supply real-time ERP delivery status updates to Project Management and Customer Success. Share accurate tracking
